scope: reference-e2e completed-run durable PostgreSQL evidence archive
invariants: PostgreSQL is an evidence archive, not a second decision engine.
No completed postgres-mode result returns before the evidence transaction commits.
The existing ArtifactStore and AuditLog semantics remain intact.
Every completed archive binds exactly ten canonical reference artifact hashes and the ordered audit hash chain.
Exact replay is idempotent; evidence substitution or rewrite fails closed.
UPDATE and DELETE are rejected at the database layer.
P002, Gate6, model logic, decision logic and capital authority are unchanged.
Capital remains LOCKED and real money remains NO.
known_boundary: v0.1 archives completed ASSURED runs atomically; it does not yet checkpoint every stage during an in-progress run.
